Maria Kowalski is an oceanologist at the Monterey Institute of Oceanography as she works with coral partners and the international administration of the Coral Reef Alliance (CRA) to improve reef health and protection. She researches shallow coral reefs, monitor surface waters to detect potentially harmful pathogens and the impact of human activities on coral reefs. Maria’s talk starts at 17:00 p.m. in the Holiday Inn Restaurant of San Francisco.
